usual_baseline: Hip fracture patients usually full weight-bearing, 95.7% [1413]. Others are not. Non-hip fragility fractures 32.3% [1413]; fragility femoral fixation 57% [1553]. After ankle fixation only 21% told early weight-bearing [1343]; 4.8% weight-bearing at 2 weeks, median 48 days [1522].
fix_that_works: No re-audit reported in these audits, so no fix has shown improvement.
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits
consultant_advice: Large national audits have already shown the gap; none closed the loop. Pick one group, such as ankle fixation or distal femur fixation, introduce a default weight-bearing pathway and re-audit. Record specific restrictions and duration, which were often missing [1506], and outcomes like length of stay and discharge home [1553].
